reason: Refactors GraphQL schema-building/type-resolution logic (moving from cached ResolvedType instances to Type-based fields and constructor-time initialization instead of Initialize(schema)) which affects all content types with indexed fields, so a mistake could break GraphQL schema generation broadly, though it's a targeted bugfix with contained scope.
